numeric_mode.description: Show IP addresses and service port numbers instead of host names.

max_udp_sources.description: Max number of simultaneous UDP sources to memorize. 0 means default/unlimited.

num_children.description: Number of child processes to spawn. 0 means default.

syslog_logging.description: Send error messages to syslog instead of stderr.

ssl_enabled.description: Enable SSL encryption/decryption for all connections.

rules.description: List of routing rules for stone to repeat packets for.
